arguments.summary: Implemented REQ-EVT-001 by normalizing each requested dimension through Geometry::clampDimension, returning before any viewport/layout/event mutation when normalized dimensions equal the current viewport, and otherwise preserving viewport update, layout, and exactly one matching event publication in order. Kept the WindowController forwarding path and all public interfaces unchanged. Updated only obsolete zero/negative initial-viewport event expectations. All 8 visible tests passed. Demonstrated STALE_INDEX rejection after editing, refreshed the index, and completed a fresh dependency traversal.
